objectName: Self-watering plant system (alt to a $129 smart auto-waterer)

steps.title: Place the 1.4L Water Reservoir Base
steps.description: Set the 3D-printed PETG water reservoir tank on a flat surface near your potted plant.

steps.title: Insert the Submersible Pump Isolation Cradle
steps.description: Lower the flanged tubular pump cradle onto the center floor of the reservoir tank with its wide flange facing down.

steps.title: Seat the 5V Submersible Water Pump
steps.description: Press the 5V mini submersible pump vertically into the isolation cradle so the intake screen sits 4mm above the floor.

steps.title: Connect the 4/6mm Silicone Delivery Tubing
steps.description: Push one end of the 4mm ID silicone tubing firmly onto the pump's top outlet barb.

steps.title: Snap on the Reservoir Grommet Lid
steps.description: Thread the silicone tube through the center 10mm hole and the pump power lead through the side 8mm grommet, then snap the lid onto the reservoir rim.

steps.title: Insert the Top Refill Funnel
steps.description: Drop the conical refill funnel into the 22mm corner port on the reservoir lid for easy top-up watering.

steps.title: Screw the Side-Mount L-Bracket to the Controller Box
steps.description: Fasten the 3D-printed L-bracket to the rear mounting holes of the controller enclosure using two M3x10mm stainless screws.

steps.title: Mount ESP32 & MOSFET Module Inside the Enclosure
steps.description: Snap the ESP32-WROOM-32 board and 5V MOSFET driver module into the controller box bays and connect the 3-wire jumper harness.

steps.title: Snap Tube Guide Clips & Flow Restrictor Wheel onto Rim
steps.description: Thread the silicone tubing through the rotary flow restrictor gear wheel and click the 4 C-clips along the reservoir rim and plant pot edge.

steps.title: Insert Soil Emitter Stakes, Moisture Probe & Connect USB-C Power
steps.description: Push the 2 drip emitter stakes and the capacitive soil moisture sensor into the plant pot soil, route the tube ends into the stake hooks, and plug in the 5V USB-C power adapter.
